name: Philosophy (PMn)

rules.name: Program of study designed with your advisor, signed and sent to the department
rules.desc:
Application Information
To apply to the Philosophy PhD Minor, please write to the graduate SSO in Philosophy and provide your CV, transcript(s), writing sample, two letters of recommendation, a statement of purpose, proposed course plan, and any other materials requested. The faculty reviews PhD minor applications around the year, there is no specific deadline. If the application is approved, then the student would submit the Ph.D. Minor Application eForm via Axess to add the PhD minor.
Prospective PhD Minors:

• Send the graduate administrator the following materials:

• CV,

• transcript(s),

• writing sample,

• two letters of recommendation,

• a statement of purpose,

• proposed course plan.

• Consult with the Director of Graduate Study to establish eligibility, and to select a suitable advisor.

• Paperwork for the minor must be submitted to the department office before beginning the program, although courses taken prior to that may be counted towards the requirements.

• Once approved, send a signed copy of the program of study (designed with the advisor).

rules.name: Philosophy PhD minor

children.name: One course numbered over 99 in each of the six areas
Two additional PHIL courses numbered over 199, both in one of the six areas
Other PHIL courses toward the 30 units

rules.desc:
• 30 units of courses in the Department of Philosophy with a letter grade of 'B-' or better in each course. No more than 3 units of directed reading may be counted in the 30-unit requirement.

• At least one course or seminar numbered over 99 to be taken in each of these six areas:

• Logic

• Philosophy of science

• Ethics, value theory, and moral and political philosophy

• Metaphysics and epistemology

• Language, mind and action

• History of philosophy

• Two additional courses numbered over 199 to be taken in one of those six areas.

grading: Courses counted toward the PhD Minor must be completed with a letter grade of B- or better.
transferPolicy: All of the coursework for a PhD minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: The audit checks 30 units of Philosophy courses, each letter graded with a B- or better, including two courses numbered 200 or above beyond your six area courses. Checked by hand: a signed program of study designed with your advisor, one course numbered over 99 in each of the six areas, which you move in, that your two 200-level courses are in the same area, and at most 3 units of directed reading. All of the coursework must be taken at Stanford.
